name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
📁 Collapsed Subfolders by Default: All subfolders now start closed with ▶ toggle icon so full folder structures are immediately visible without endless scrolling.
🚀 Fluid Touch Scrolling & Sliced Items Fix: Playlist batch list expands up to 60vh with smooth touch momentum scrolling; eliminates clipped items.
✨ Zero Dead Space: Eliminated excessive negative bottom padding and 100vh stretch across views for a tighter, native mobile layout.
🎨 Minimalist Theme Cards: Removed emojis/icons from Pure AMOLED, Liquid Glass, and Cyber Aurora theme cards for a clean, minimal typography look.
